To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
corporate goals for information technology (IT), and management practices, such as strategic alignment, contribute to higher levels of perceived IT business value.

Corporate goals for IT are important predictors of IT business value and that management practices such IT alignment and IT investment analysis also play a significant role in determining IT business value.

(1) the goals for IT within the firm are a significant predictor of perceived business value; (2) the management practices of the firm are a predictor of perceived business benefits; (3) the goals for and the management practices of IT are significant predictors of IT payoffs across the entire value chain; (4) the management practices and goals for IT interact to produce significant effects; and (5) IT payoffs vary by firm size.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

IT is a critical component of the value chain and that firms can improve their ability to capture value from IT by developing focused goals for IT and implementing effective practices for managing IT.
IT business value is a process that involves the interaction of IT goals, management practices, and IT impacts across the value chain.
the business value of information technology is a function of both the goals of the organization and management practices.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a comprehensive approach to evaluating IT business value requires an understanding of corporate goals and management practices as well as the impacts of IT across the value creation process.
IT business value is not a static construct but is a dynamic outcome of the interplay between corporate goals, management practices and IT capabilities.

IT business value can be measured by assessing IT impacts on critical business processes within the value chain and that the level of business value realized is a function of corporate goals for IT, management practices, and IT investment evaluation.
